jsonld_raw.name: (125 G) CARAMEL LATTE SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made with vegetable waxes.

Caramel latte | An invitation to enjoy a sweet and refreshing moment, where the intense aroma of coffee blends with the enveloping softness of caramel. The fragrance opens with an irresistible accord of biscuit, praline, and chocolate, which gives way to a creamy heart of freshly brewed coffee, sugar, and cookie. In the base, milk and vanilla intertwine with musk, creating a soft, gourmand, and delicately addictive trail.

Olfactory notes:
Top notes: Biscuit, praline, chocolate
Heart notes: Coffee, sugar, cookie
Base notes: Vanilla, musk, milk

The candle comes in a cylindrical enameled ceramic container with an aged finish.
